(3) Scope unclear: undetermined. A driver's claim of agreement that appears only in his statement is not consent (G11); a complete chat record with no rider agreement before the segment: counts. This finding changes no amount (fixed fare) and no flag: if you cannot settle it, undetermined is allowed and the case may still be ruled.
